name: touvoir
description: TOUVOIR — site web et application Android de vidéosurveillance en Côte d’Ivoire

scripts.build: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build:web
scripts.check:js: for f in assets/js/*.js src/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
